description: A house 30 feet by 20 with its south-east corner cut at 45 degrees and that cut a gable, at 9 in 12 to its south: a gable's length is never in question, since it does not move, so the roof is derived though the gable is 4 feet times the square root of 2 long. Its gable end is a triangle up to the point where the south and east planes meet over it.
